text:
Zoe (sales): Quick decision needed. BetaBank wants a 10-business-day pilot. Must be EU-resident, want KMS + SIEM, and care about predictable p95 latency. Can we agree a recommended mode today?
Arjun (presales): Two viable tracks: Hosted-EU for fastest ramp, Dedicated-EU for isolation & static egress. Private only if they require air-gapped HSM.
Tom (customer-eng): BetaBank target load: 30-60 req/s with bursts. They also want a pinned model + an eval set of 150 prompts (some long).
Marta (security): From their SQ: must see KMS key usage logs, SAML for admin, and log forwarding (syslog). Hosted supports customer-managed KMS and syslog export, but HSM-backed keys require Dedicated/Private HSM addon.
Zoe (sales): Procurement asks: delta in cost for a 2-week pilot at ~80k tokens/day?
Arjun (presales): Hosted: pay-as-you-go, lower up-front, estimate ~ $EST_HOSTED. Dedicated: one-month min ~ $EST_DEDICATED + lower unit costs. For 2 weeks Hosted likely cheaper.
Tom (customer-eng): Can Hosted pin a model and pre-warm cache for the eval set?
Arjun (presales): Yes. Example hosted config we'll propose:
```
mode: hosted
region: eu-west-1
model_pin: rwd-3.1
kms: customer-managed
prewarm_eval: true
```
ops-bot: Note: Dedicated cluster provisioning ETA = 4 business days after approval. Run `ops cluster status` to confirm capacity.
Marta (security): Action items: I'll annotate the SQ and flag any items that force Dedicated/Private (HSM, private peering-only SIEM).
Zoe (sales): Proposed success criteria for pilot: 1) quality >= 85% on 150 prompts, 2) p95 latency <= 300ms, 3) demo cost within procurement budget, 4) KMS + syslog validated.
Tom (customer-eng): Timeline: kickoff Mon -> run evals Tue-Thu -> demo next Mon. If HSM required day-0, we need to push.
Arjun (presales): I'll prepare two runbooks (hosted-eu and dedicated-eu), cost delta, and a short tech appendix on routing and fallbacks.
Zoe (sales): Great. I'll tell BetaBank we recommend Hosted-EU for trial, Dedicated as the production ramp path unless they insist on HSM or private SIEM.
Marta (security): Upload SQ responses by EOD.
Zoe (sales): Thanks team, will update customer after Arjun posts numbers.
